exposure: sonographic findings suggestive of ovarian edema
cohort: Pregnant women who underwent urgent laparoscopy for suspected adnexal torsion during 2004-2019
finding: Right lower abdominal pain, shorter symptom duration (< 24 hrs), vomiting, and sonographic findings suggestive of ovarian edema were positively associated with adnexal torsion, while previous cesarean delivery and normal-appearing ovaries on ultrasound were negatively associated.
mod_finding: Previous cesarean delivery was negatively associated with adnexal torsion.
gest_age: Not specified, but study population includes pregnant women
